sql: SELECT t.primary_title, t.start_year, t.average_rating, t.num_votes, ROUND(t.average_rating / LOG10(t.num_votes + 1), 4) AS hidden_gem_score FROM titles t WHERE t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.average_rating >= 8.5 AND t.num_votes < 5000 AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.average_rating DESC, t.num_votes ASC
